profile.headline: Software Developer at Lawrence Livermore National Labrotory
profile.summary: Full-Stack developer with 6 years of experience. Focus on customer satisfaction and usability by incorporating previous successful strategies, emphasizing performance and stability, and providing a strategic direction for our technical stack to rest of my team. I’m eager to work with passionate developers in a fast paced environment that rewards creativity and breadth of knowledge.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Full-Stack Developer (ID as a Service, Senior Software Engineer) - Remote

2018 - Present

Advised a team on languages and frameworks by creating 5 prototypes and presenting an assessment of the most inviting UI, customer usability, and developer productivity resulting in the adoption of my professional recommendation.

Primary contributor to the design and modernization of a new IDM system, including features such as authorization control (teams, users, & roles), self-service for external customers to request integrations with existing systems, and presenting audit information on various identity activities using React, Kotlin, and NextJS.

As technical lead, designed and implemented an integration with an existing Identity Management (IDM) environment to high security environments using Go, Azure CosmosDB (MongoDB), and Svelte enabling identity proofing and role assignment of hundreds of thousands of users.

Autonomously created an admin dashboard for managing high security IDM environments, allowing the configuration and control of time-sensitive jobs, identity reassignments, and various auditing capabilities.
Major contributor to a new Lab IDM project by creating novel features spanning the UI, APIs, and database, performing major version upgrades of Angular, refactoring and polishing several areas of the UI based on user feedback.

Continually developed skills and produce additional value through hackathons in the following topics: explored the use of machine learning in identity proofing, performance improvements using graalVM, visualizing identity authentication data on a rotating 3D globe.

Technical Lead for the High Explosive Applications Facility responsible for customer requirement gathering, software release cycles of two projects, and planned sprints for one employee.

Created mobile inventory tracking application utilizing React, MobX, Webpack, PWAs, and Ping Federate (OAuth) that integrated seamlessly with the legacy inventory tracking system.
positions.insights: Skills: Cross-browser Compatibility · GraphQL · TypeScript · Front-End Development · Representational State Transfer (REST) · React Native · Web Applications · Communication

company.name: Software Engineering Institute | Carnegie Mellon University

positions.title: Software Development intern
positions.description: I wrote system tests for an I/O box used in multiple types of aircraft.

positions.title: Applications Development Intern
positions.description: Developed applications using the ASP .NET, Entity Framework, SSMS, SSIS, C#, and AngularJS.

positions.title: Office Assistant
positions.description: I assisted with inter-office labor, organized and planned schedules, and assisted students seeking career advice.

positions.title: Leadership Intern
positions.description: I worked with grass roots organizations in various ways to increase the quality of life in Topeka. Responsibilities included: Planning events; attending meetings throughout town to recognize what was going on and identifying areas that could be paired together or areas that needed help; managing content for the website; and tracking fundraising.

positions.title: Member Service Representitive
positions.description: I handled large amounts of cash, practiced discretion towards member's accounts, handled a large volume of telephone calls and assisted with problems as presented, and practiced customer service through face to face interaction.

volunteerExperiences.description: Currently, I coordinate volunteer efforts for this event to increase education about ovarian cancer. Participation has increased steadily each year and currently, we have more than 500 walkers attending.
